1047818222.annotation: Only item in shop vs DOT damage (Infernus/Pocket/Shiv) & any control (Mo/Holiday)

865958998.annotation: Alternative to Fortitude. Nice for rotating around the map, ganking, escaping/survivability, and the heal is great. At the moment I don't like this too much since it doesn't work in the tunnels.

1414025773.annotation: Block big strong ults. Against Lash/Wraith/Talon/Shiv/Rem/Pocket etc

630839635.annotation: TESTING/ Slash >Arctic >Bomb >Echo >Bomb, will do around 1k~ more dmg

1342610602.annotation: Worth going early now for Point Blank if you prefer that. Nice for melee resist as well. If you want to kill minions and objectives, its as good as Monster Rounds.

2407781327.annotation: Big resists, hp and overall tankiness, nice vs everything but not op. Curse counters

3357231760.annotation: Really great in late teamfights. Especially good if you are really struggling against CC. Or for midboss.

3028234315.annotation: Kind of a meme item. Very situational. Only get against lots of incremental spirit damage (McGinnis turrets, Infernus, Warden Ult) and have Spirit Resilience already.

1371725689.annotation: Good for shutting down fliers and gun carries. And for getting on top of the people you need to target in team fights.

1710079648.annotation: Better than extra regen if you need heal fast after fight + useful for whole game cuz movespeed

3633614685.annotation: Gets you your 4.8k vitality spike. You can build this into Fortitude or Colossus. You can buy this earlier during laning to help with survivability. If you went Dispel Magic already, skip this.

3585132399.annotation: The health is great for survivability, the move speed is great for rotating, and the heal lets you stay on the map longer. I prefer this over VW cause it works in the tunnels. Or go Dispel Magic here.

2163598980.annotation: If you need anti-spirit. Very common buy although not absolutely necessary since we build many items that have spirit resist already. Really strong at the moment.

3140772621.annotation: For bullet resist. If it's early, probably just go Battle Vest instead though. If it's late and you've got Transcendent Cooldown I would just go Metal Skin instead.

3970837787.annotation: Great for more spirit resist early. Cooldown reduction is really rare so this is a great item since it gives you some.

112198670.annotation: Better CD and Passive stats than from Reactive + gives spirit res on activation

2059712766.annotation: 10% spirit resist for 1.6k and the health and the stamina is really nice.

1925087134.annotation: Great at stopping gun carries. Easy to proc and can proc on many people.

2095565695.annotation: Feels pretty good. It is now fixed for your 2! Difficult on slots though. Good for melee resist if you need that.

1798666702.annotation: I think the stats from this are really good. The invisibility is bugged with cat form I think though, so just be wary of that. Hunter's Aura is usually better.

1396247347.annotation: Great for damage and ammo, replaces Stalker.

1282141666.annotation: Might be quite nice against tanks if you've gone into more gun late game.

3361811174.annotation: If you are actually like the only player on your team doing anything and you have like 65k souls you could get this.

334300056.annotation: fun item, good value, mmm mmmmovement. You could buy this in the mid game some time rather than getting resists perhaps.

3270001687.annotation: Good for movement and the bullet resist is nice.

2617435668.annotation: If you really need to screw over someone in particular.

2800629741.annotation: Fun and silly! Also good escape tool. Just worse to get than other 6ks though. Meme item.

2947183272.annotation: Kind of fun, but not very good. Adds up to a decent amount of heal in longer fights since Torment Pulse and Scourge easily procs it.

1254091416.annotation: If no one else on your team is going to buy this and you really need to stop a Vindicta/GT or Seven ult.

3144988365.annotation: I don't think this is really all that worth it compared to just getting Healbane. Since any person incredibly reliant on healing will just get Debuff Remover. But maybe get against Mo or Abrams.

1102081447.annotation: Just feels really nice, makes it super easy to hit your ults second/end damage burst.

1219329868.annotation: Builds into Focus Lens, easy to use and great for 1v1s. Makes your burst stronger.

1998374645.annotation: Your bombs can't really proc this anymore. So you can only proc it with Cold Front/Arctic Blast and your ult.

1235347618.annotation: The bullet resist and regen is great in lane. Later though you should just get Bullet Resilience. Also good for farming denizens.

3361075077.annotation: Good against Graves and gun carries.

805079544.annotation: Spirit shielding but for gun dmg with less CD, good vs melee/gun chars, can take double shielding

2226497419.annotation: If you're going more into gun later then this might be good.

709540378.annotation: Possible item for your 4.8k Weapon Investment, but imo it's not that necessary on Calico.

3403085434.annotation: Not as good since the speed stacking nerf. I still like it though. Good for movespeed in ult and catform. Combine with a 3.2k weapon item to get your 4.8k investment spike.
